fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone that deals 6 damage, throws everything in it back 3 tiles and makes it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stench Burst
fusions.desc: Spits a glob of foulness that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Lingering Dread
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and whoever strikes you is made [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Not Twice
fusions.desc: When anything other than fire hurts you, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 15 seconds.
